newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 12.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

CBA announced a 11 percent rise in first half profit to A$602 million, well above the A$535 million to A$560 million analysts had forecast. CBA said better than expected business volumes and good cost control led to the better than expected result. It said this was likely to lead to a better than expected full year result.

Seven is expected to release its first half profit results around mid-morning. Analysts contacted by Reuters expect Seven Network to report a net profit of between A$59 million and A$65 million for the 26 weeks ended December 28. Seven reported a net profit of A$91.88 million in the 1995/96 half, but no tax was paid.

Helix Resources shares closed down A$1.263 at A$3.727 on Tuesday after the company released more drilling results from its Timkillia prospect in the Gawler Craton region of South Australia that analysts described as disappointing. Acacia bought 17.4 percent of Acacia last week.
Brambles Industries Ltd said late on Tuesday it would not increase its A$2.00 per share bid for document exchange firm Ausdoc Group Ltd and expected its offer to lapse at the end of this month.
* Mount Edon Gold Mines Ltd A$2.11 (-0.03)

Mount Edon Gold Mines (Australia) Ltd said late on Tuesday that Camelot Resources NL and Canada's Teck Corp had increased their takeover offer for Mount Edon to A$2.25 per share from A$2.15 per share. Mt Edon said its board had decided to unanimously recommend shareholders accept the increased offer.
